content: LNBits withdraw (LNURLw) extension is the closest existing primitive: Quick Vouchers creates batch LNURL-withdraw QR codes (same amount, printable, single-use), Advanced LNURLw supports title, min/max range, scan count, time-between-withdraws, and unique-QR anti-exploitation. Custom SVG templates supported. No dedicated 'gift cards' extension exists in core LNBits; Satoshi Engineering's TipCards project wraps LNBits LNURLw for gift/tip use case with status tracking. LNBits Bolt Cards extension writes LNURLw to NFC. No email delivery, no recipient metadata, no expiry at the wallet/extension level.
